testCase.name: [本地] S19 Every window is one configuration value (code and deployment review)

descriptionHtml:
要人拍板 D6 · P1 · Daniela

转录 / 保留时长和 UAT 3.6 不一致：归档 48 小时（不是 36）、养老院保留 3 次访视（不是 2 次）、「Earlier sessions」和「Most Recent」不带日期、快速口述框永不过期、保留时长写死在代码里（是不是要做成配置）

同一个问题的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-16/S10, TC-16/S11, TC-16/S14, TC-16/S23, TC-16/S27, TC-11/S28, TC-04/S10

思路 / Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S19 「每个窗口都是一个配置值（看代码和部署）」 Every window is one configuration value (code and deployment review)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U12 All retention windows are configuration values, not hard-coded, so they can be lengthened later under a hospital affiliation.（UAT OAT-04 (B)；UAT 3.6；TFA-94699 AC 7） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given The main source at e02167f (read-only) and the local stack's environment only (never dev or production); one window of each class: 12 h, 16 h, 18 h, 36 h, Nursing Home visit count. The production environment check goes to Tim with S02

When Find where each window in the TFA-94699 table is defined and how it would be lengthened

Then Every window is read from one configuration value and no other code path has its own copy of the number; whether that value must be changeable without a code change and release is Q11

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT 3.6 / OAT-04 (B) 'all windows are configuration values, not hard-coded' and TFA-94699 AC 7. Both outcomes recorded now: the windows are named constants HOSPITAL_RETENTION / SNF_RETENTION in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:8-38 with no env or settings row, so Pass if Q11 = 'a named constant is enough', Fail if Q11 = 'changeable without a release'. …

在哪跑：本地 code-review（读代码判）；测试方法 CODEREVIEW · 代码审查；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S19 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-04.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；要拍板的人：Daniela / Tim。

问题分类：要人拍板（Daniela / Tim） · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94699 in progress

医生看不到：保留时长是代码里的命名常量（HOSPITAL_RETENTION / SNF_RETENTION），不改代码发版就改不了；这算不算「时长是配置值」还没定（Q11）。

Nothing a physician sees: the retention windows are named constants in code (HOSPITAL_RETENTION / SNF_RETENTION), not values that can change without a release, and whether that meets 'windows are config values' is open (Q11).

依据：allure 53f1cd0a-…-result.json; code-review/OAT-04-S19.json; K9 confirmed at lifecycle.ts:8 and :30. One new code note: the NH PreviousNotesPanel.tsx:23/60 keeps its own copy of the 3-note cap instead of reading SNF_RETENTION. The 18 h 'not mentioned today' label (MedicationsPanel.tsx) exists only on the client. Context: open tasks and handoffs have no window entry (K2/K3), points are 18 h, not 12 h, and NH keeps 3 visits, not 2. Production env overrides: Tim.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane code-review。

测试方法：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查；辅助：CONFIG · 配置核对 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：code-review。

UAT item: OAT-04 Data Retention · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-04/S19

Every window is one configuration value (code and deployment review)

Tickets: TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

本地新 lane code-review：code-review/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 没写 productIssue，按它的 physicianImpact 算））。

Detail:

The verdict is pending: nothing fails under either answer to Q11, but two points wait on it. The server windows are defined once, in two module constants in apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts. HOSPITAL_RETENTION (lines 8-28) holds pre-round 12h, important points 18h, encounter and note 18h, done task 16h, medication, previous note and objective data (vitals, labs, imaging) 36h, and encounter archive 48h. SNF_RETENTION (lines 30-38) holds pre-round 12h, encounter 12h, note 18h, done task 16h, and transcript, previous-note and medication visit counts of 3. hospitalLifecyclePatch and snfLifecyclePatch read every window through these objects. I searched apps/web (convex and src) for hour arithmetic (N * HOUR, 60*60*1000, 12/16/18/36 hours). No other code path keeps its own copy of any window the objects define, so there is no kind-(a) copy. That copy is the only point the oracle fails under either answer to Q11. The windows themselves are compile-time constants with no environment or settings row. That is known gap K9: it passes if Q11 = 'a named constant is enough' and fails if Q11 = 'changeable without a release'. One window is defined only outside the objects (kind b): the client constant NOT_MENTIONED_AFTER_MS = 18h in MedicationsPanel.tsx. It sets when a hospital medication is labelled "not mentioned today" and has no entry in HOSPITAL_RETENTION, so it is pending:Q11 (and on whether a label threshold counts as a retention window). Context only: open tasks and handoffs (36h in the table) have no window entry or clearing code anywhere. Important points is 18h in the config, not the table's 12h. The Nursing Home visit counts are 3, not 2. These are value or coverage differences for other scenarios, not copies.

产品问题（按 physicianImpact）：lane 没写 productIssue，失败·产品按它的 physicianImpact 算（全文见下）。

等开放问题（pendingOn）：

  • Q11

新发现（newFindings）：

  • apps/web/src/features/snf/patient/panels/PreviousNotesPanel.tsx:23: COPY: the Nursing Home Previous Notes panel holds its own number for the same window (3) instead of reading SNF_RETENTION.previousNotes. It caps adding notes and drives the n/3 badge.
  • apps/web/src/features/snf/patient/panels/PreviousNotesPanel.tsx:60: The copied number gates adding a Nursing Home previous note.

确认的已知缺口（knownGapsConfirmed）：

  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:8: The hospital windows are defined once as a module constant (pre-round 12h, important points 18h, encounter and note 18h, done task 16h, medication, previous note and objective data 36h), with no environment or settings source.
  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:30: The Nursing Home windows are a second module constant with no environment or settings row. The visit counts are 3.
  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:8: Hospital windows are named module constants, not an env value or a settings row (K9).
  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:30: Nursing Home windows, including the visit counts, are named module constants (K9).

开放问题（openQuestions）：

  • Q11: Is a named constant in code enough, or must every window be changeable without a code change and release? This decides K9 (HOSPITAL_RETENTION / SNF_RETENTION) and the client-only NOT_MENTIONED_AFTER_MS.
  • Does the 18h "not mentioned today" medication label count as a TFA-94699 retention window, or is it only a display threshold?
  • The table lists open tasks and handoffs at 36h, but the code has no window or clearing for them; the same goes for important points at 12h (code: 18h) and Nursing Home at 2 visits (code: 3). These belong to the value and coverage scenarios, not this one.
  • Q11: must the windows be changeable without a code change and release, or is a named constant enough? This decides K9 and the hospital previous-notes cap of 3 and the 18h medication label, which are defined only outside the config.
  • Do the hospital Previous Notes cap (3) and the 18h 'not mentioned today' label count as retention windows under U12?
  • The configured values differ from the TFA-94699 figures in the question (Important Points 18h vs 12h; Nursing Home visit counts 3 vs 2). This should be checked in the scenario that verifies the window values.
  • The TFA-94699 table lists open tasks and handoffs at 36h, but the config has no entry for them. Is that a missing window or deliberate?

代码定不了（notDecidableByCode）：

  • Whether the deployed (production or dev) environment overrides any window: production check goes to Tim with S02
  • Whether U12 requires changing a window at runtime without a release (Q11)
  • Production environment check (Tim, with S02)
  • Whether a named constant meets 'configuration value' in U12 (Q11)

对医生的影响（physicianImpact）：To lengthen any retention window (for example under a hospital affiliation), a developer has to edit lifecycle.ts and release new code; an admin cannot change it in settings or the environment. The 18h "not mentioned today" medication label lives separately in the web client, so it needs its own client change and release. / If the Nursing Home previous-notes window were lengthened in the server config, the Previous Notes panel would still stop the physician adding a note at 3 and show "3/3", so the app would not behave the same everywhere. A hospital affiliation's longer windows would also need code changes in several client files, not just one value.

审查结论（verdict）：fail

证据：附了 2 个。

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: outside-runner (manual: no-oracle). This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
